newsitem.title: POLAND: PPWK RIGHTS SECOND LEG OVERSUBSCRIBED.
newsitem.headline: PPWK RIGHTS SECOND LEG OVERSUBSCRIBED.

text.p: Investors subscribed for 295,839 shares of Polish map maker Polskie Przedsiebiorstwo Wydawnictw Kartograficznych SA (PPWK) in the 29,946-share second leg of the firm's one-for-two rights issue, the firm said on Friday.

It said in a statement that as a result of the successful second leg, all 885,534 shares in the issue at 12 zlotys a share had been taken up without the help of its underwriters. It gave no further details.
The issue's first phase of 885,534 shares last month was 97-percent subscribed.

It was underwritten by Petrobank and Eastbrokers Warszawski Dom Maklerski SA brokerage, which agreed to underwrite 175,000 and 125,000 shares respectively for a fee of two percent of the value of underwritten shares.
